open_points.subject: PortalStore.begin schema creation dispatch
open_points.text: “Every module:portal_store transaction … begins by creating any missing table … one schema function per repository” and State 3 says portal_store owns “schema creation through the repositories”, but the change says “so no generated module calls them.”
open_points.question: Does the generated PortalStore.begin implementation call the ten repository create_*_schema capabilities, or does backend lowering perform equivalent schema work without those module calls?
options: PortalStore.begin calls each repository schema capability in the listed accessor order.
Backend-generated code creates the schemas without calling the repository capabilities.
open_points.default_guess: Have PortalStore.begin call the repository schema capabilities in the listed order.

witness.initial: A service starts against a SQLite database missing one or more repository tables, with repository schema capabilities instrumented.
events: The deployment process creates the runtime application.
module:runtime opens a module:portal_store transaction, causing PortalStore.begin to ensure schemas.
outcomes: PortalStore.begin invokes each repository create_*_schema capability in accessor order, as the flow’s first sentence and State 3 ownership imply.
No generated module invokes those capabilities; backend lowering performs or injects the schema creation directly, as the changed sentence states.
witness.observer: A repository-capability verification test or maintainer tracing PortalStore.begin sees whether the calls occur.
